notes.title: BIG Sexy Tails update is here!
notes.notes:
Hello there! 

Long time no see - and we're back with a big update! What's inside?

it's easier now!

It's been a while since we had revised the puzzles and recalled the souls-like difficulty we created. Long story short - we've finally made the levels in each and every puzzle easier! If you've been stuck on the level for a while, now is your time to avenge yourself and finally get all the content you've wanted! 

But there's so much to do for those who've got all the achievements already - we've added even more achievements to hunt down! And when we say more, we mean MORE. Got it? 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40091462/2bb43226b019a25d3f370b982d46cdd0760a511c.png

International understanding

We also added translations on languages that weren't presented before the update. We're looking forward to see new friends from all over the globe, welcome!

Animations also got the much deserved update - they are now voice acted, and there's no way you won't get your heart and pants melted from them. Needless to say, it's your sign to start training for "the fastest hand of the Wild West" title.

If you want to support us directly, check out the DLC section - high quality artworks and voiced videos are neatly packed for you to enjoy! 

And if it's not enough - we invite you to check out the bundle we've prepared with our fellow furry friends. It's a nice way to spend a few evenings in the most pleasurable way (and with a nice discount, of course):

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/44313/FURRY/

Hentai lovers, this one is for you! Check out Summer For You - a spicy visual novel where you’ll have to win the hearts of stunning girls! Get loved or get doomed!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2066980/Summer_For_You/

That's all for now, there's no time to waste - let's go and play the game together!

notes.title: Update
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! 

We’ve updated the game yesterday, making the worst of the D’n’H levels easier.

I hope you’ll find it more fun and much less frustrating now! If you have other thoughts and ideas for the game - leave a comment here or post something on the discussion board! We’ll definitely try to improve the game (and our future ones!) as much as possible.

And please leave a (honest!) review if you played the game. We’d love to add trading cards, backgrounds and point shop items to the game, but we need community engagement for that!
